summary: Backend testing: 11/11 pytest cases PASS (TASK 1 instant-demand fields on /api/flights, TASK 2 daily-summary 4 sections + sources + queries + auth-gated regenerate, trains regression). Frontend testing: TASK 1 Aviones works perfectly — all 3 terminal cards render the original 'XA - YP' counters, the original 'Previsión Próxima Hora · Score X.X' chip preserved verbatim, and the NEW 'Demanda en este Momento' bar with %, trend dash and progress bar below it; testIDs instant-demand-T1/T2/T4 all confirmed in DOM. TASK 2 FAILS in the frontend — the Eventos tab shows ONLY 'Añadir Evento' button and 'No hay eventos para hoy' empty state. The AI daily-summary card is NOT rendered: testIDs ai-daily-summary-card, ai-daily-summary-refresh-btn, ai-daily-summary-text are ABSENT from DOM; 'Resumen del Día' header is absent; none of the 4 section headers [GRANDES EVENTOS] / [TEATROS Y OCIO] / [ALERTAS DE TRÁFICO] / [PREVISIÓN MAÑANA] render in the Eventos tab. Backend GET /api/events/daily-summary returns a fully-formed payload (4 sections, 17 search queries, 26 sources, **bold** markers) so this is purely a frontend integration bug — the card component in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (line ~11206-11365 per the request) either isn't being mounted under the Eventos tab or the fetchDailySummary path isn't being triggered after login.

ui_bugs.issue: Card is NOT rendered. testIDs ai-daily-summary-card / ai-daily-summary-refresh-btn / ai-daily-summary-text are absent from DOM. Title 'Resumen del Día' and the 4 section headers [GRANDES EVENTOS] / [TEATROS Y OCIO] / [ALERTAS DE TRÁFICO] / [PREVISIÓN MAÑANA] are absent. Eventos tab only shows the existing 'Añadir Evento' button and 'No hay eventos para hoy' empty state.

integration_issues.issue: Backend /api/events/daily-summary returns 200 with full payload (4 sections, 17 queries, 26 sources, **bold** segments), but the frontend Eventos tab does not display it. Likely causes: (a) the dailySummary JSX block at line ~11206-11365 isn't inside the active branch when activeTab/section==='eventos', (b) fetchDailySummary at line ~3625-3645 isn't being invoked on tab change, or (c) the component is conditioned on a state variable that is never set to truthy.

action_items: URGENT: Wire up the AI daily-summary card in the Eventos tab. The backend endpoint works; the JSX block at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx ~11206-11365 is not rendering. Verify: (1) the card is inside the eventos tab render branch (not inside the wrong section like 'calle' or 'aviones'), (2) fetchDailySummary() is called inside a useEffect on tab change OR on initial mount, (3) the conditional render isn't gated on dailySummary state being null when it should fall back to a loading state.

Note on Score chip: the request said the chip text must be EXACTLY 'Score: X.X', but the actual GitHub-restored chip reads 'Previsión Próxima Hora · Score 2.0' (no colon, with prefix). This matches what was rendered before the changes, so the 'restore to GitHub' was done correctly — the request wording was likely shorthand. No action needed unless main agent confirms otherwise.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is ~18000 lines; the Eventos tab and the daily-summary card live thousands of lines apart, which makes wiring errors like this easy to introduce. Strong recommendation to extract DailySummaryCard into its own component file.
Backend /api/events/daily-summary correctly handles cache hits in <1s and cache misses (regenerate) in ~30s. Auth on POST /regenerate works (401 without token, 200 with admin). No backend issues.

instant_demand_pct/level/trend are correctly populated per terminal in /api/flights and are stable (regression: original score_30min, score_60min, total_next_30min, total_next_60min, past_30min, past_60min are all preserved).
Trains endpoint regression: /api/trains returns 200 with Atocha+Chamartín arrivals (live RENFE data).

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 pytest pass: instant-demand fields, daily-summary structure, regenerate auth, trains regression)
success_rate.frontend: 50% (TASK 1 Aviones instant-demand bar fully working with correct testIDs and original Score chip preserved; TASK 2 Eventos AI daily-summary card NOT rendered at all)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: 3 inputs on landing — inputs[0]=Calculadora-destino (skip), inputs[1]=username, inputs[2]=password; click 'Entrar' then wait ~9s. To open Aviones: open the section dropdown which shows the current section label (e.g. 'Calle') by clicking it, then click the 'Aviones' option (force=True). To open Eventos: click the dropdown again and click 'Eventos'. testIDs validated working on Aviones: instant-demand-T1 ('Demanda en este Momento 0%'), instant-demand-T2 ('...3%'), instant-demand-T4 ('...0%'). Pytest: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://tariff-tool.preview.emergentagent.com PYTHONPATH=/app pytest backend/tests/test_instant_demand_and_summary.py -v`. The Eventos card bug is reproducible on every fresh load after login → switch to Eventos.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend daily-summary works end-to-end (curl confirms 200 with summary+sources+queries+date+generated_at, 4 sections, **bold** markers). Frontend Eventos tab does NOT render the daily-summary card — the testIDs ai-daily-summary-card / -refresh-btn / -text are entirely absent from the DOM after navigating to Eventos. Reproduction: login admin/admin → open dropdown → click 'Eventos' → wait 12s → inspect DOM. Expected: a card titled 'Resumen del Día' with subtitle 'Eventos verificados · IA con Google Search' above the 'Añadir Evento' button. Observed: only the 'Añadir Evento' button and the 'No hay eventos para hoy' empty state. Most likely root cause: the JSX for the daily-summary card at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx ~11206-11365 is either (a) outside the conditional branch for the eventos tab, (b) gated on a state variable (e.g. dailySummary) that is never populated because fetchDailySummary() isn't called on tab activation, or (c) inside a conditional that short-circuits when no events exist. Main agent should verify the JSX placement, ensure fetchDailySummary fires in a useEffect keyed on the active section/tab, and confirm the loading/error/success states all render the card shell (not just on success).
